sanitizer_exception: ThorVG's pinned source replaces global operator new with malloc. This triggers AddressSanitizer's alloc-dealloc-mismatch check in libFuzzer's own startup vector before input parsing; the image disables only that mismatch check while retaining ASan memory checks and UBSan.
coverage: LLVM source coverage in ThorVG SVG loader, C API binding, and software renderer, built with Meson from the pinned release and reached by a C byte-input harness through tvg_picture_load_data
parser_family: ThorVG 1.1.3 SVG loader (src/loaders/svg) through the C API binding (src/bindings/capi); same pinned source and SVG loader as the ThorVG C++ API path, so the C and C++ paths are one parser engine reached from two harness languages, not independent engines
